intro.title: Card Component
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a reusable Card component in Angular to display content like a title, description, and an image in a structured layout. You'll learn how to create a component using the Angular CLI, define its template with HTML, and style it with CSS. The core concept is component-based architecture, which allows you to break the UI into independent, reusable pieces. You'll use TypeScript for the component logic and Angular's decorators like @Component to configure it. By the end, you'll have a functional Card component that can be easily integrated into other parts of an Angular application.
intro.usecase: Card components are a foundational UI pattern used across modern web applications to present grouped information in a contained, visually distinct unit. You'll see them in product dashboards like GitHub's repository overview cards, e-commerce sites displaying product listings, or news feeds showing article previews. As an Angular developer, you'll frequently build and customize card components to create consistent, reusable layouts for user profiles, settings panels, or data summaries, making your UI modular and maintainable.
